scope: Incremental disposition map. Unlisted legacy declarations remain pending; original inventory is unchanged. No legacy-name aliases are installed.

entries.implemented: Bounded SELECT pages with explicit target/identity; optional local CSV/NDJSON page artifacts, checksums, retention and text chunks shared across MCP clients.
entries.remaining: Legacy request/result compatibility, materialized full executions, cursor/export continuation, multi-page exports, jobs and custom-path download UI. A saved artifact covers one returned page only.

entries.implemented: Bounded script metadata, explicit identity, deterministic pages, optional sharing and data-source filters for exact scriptId, case-insensitive exact type and name/owner substrings.
entries.remaining: Legacy fuzzy search, all-row response semantics and exact compatibility adapter. Native name/owner substrings treat percent/underscore literally rather than as LIKE wildcards.

entries.implemented: Immediate child folder and file metadata using separate bounded read actions; negative system folder IDs supported.
entries.remaining: Combined legacy response, URL fields, legacy string folder IDs and compatibility adapter. Separate reads do not form an atomic snapshot.

entries.implemented: Root/child folder pages and file metadata through the broker, independent of the context-picker renderer.
entries.remaining: Combined result, folder info, breadcrumbs, context-picker integration and null-to-omitted-ID compatibility. Root selection uses the current Orvane IsTopLevel predicate.
The new action lists deployment metadata by positive script ID. Legacy behavior filters by record type and includes source code; it is not implemented by this action.

entries.implemented: Global bounded File Cabinet file metadata search by exact positive file ID, case-insensitive literal name substring, or their conjunction; explicit target/identity and stable pages.
entries.remaining: Legacy string IDs, flat name argument, URL fields and exact compatibility adapter. File content remains separate and pending.

entries.implemented: Global bounded folder metadata search by exact nonzero folder ID (including system folders), literal case-insensitive name substring, or their conjunction.
entries.remaining: Legacy string IDs, flat name argument, empty-criteria behavior and exact compatibility adapter. Native search requires an ID or a nonempty bounded name.
File contents, binary/PDF handling and artifacts are not implemented by metadata-only files reads.
Script execution logs and legacy date/type filters remain outside this batch.
